title: 医用生体工学
subtitle: Bioengineering
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1)	Learn the structure of organisms and biological functions.
(2)	Learn about medical equipment.
(3)	Learn about the application of engineering to medicine
advice:
This is a basic course in bioengineering. We will cover the following topics:

1. Role and position of bioengineering in society
2. Importance of bioengineering
3. Basic anatomy and physiology
4. Regenerative medicine
5. Biometrics
6. Surgical instruments
7. Therapeutic equipment
8. Artificial organs
9. Drug delivery system

requiredKnowledge: Students are expected to be have completed Basic Biology

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Propose new machines to which bioengineering is applied
(2) Propose new machines useful for medical care.
(3) Propose new measurement methods of vital information.
(4) Propose fuyther improvemnt of advanced medical technology
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Explain a machine to which bioengineering is applied
(2) Explain the invasiveness of a medical machine.
(3) Explain the principle of a device to measure vital information.
(4) Explain an advanced medical technology
